title: Holds on books that are out
ask: Approve the plan for holds on books that are out, and answer the question that blocks the endpoints.
note: One feature across two repos. One rule in the model still breaks in this plan, and its note tells you why the plan accepts it.

product.problem: Members cannot reserve a book that is out. They ask at the desk, and the desk keeps a paper list for each book. Two members can be promised the same copy, and a returned copy can go back on the open shelf while someone still waits for it.

users.need: Places a hold from the book page, sees their place in line, and picks the copy up from the hold shelf.
Shelves a returned copy for the next member in line, and cancels a hold when a member asks at the desk.

product.notFor: Branch managers. Reports on which books people wait for come in a later plan.
goals: A member can hold any book whose copies are all out, without asking at the desk.
Each returned copy goes to the first member in line, and that member hears about it the same day.

nonGoals.what: Holds on a book with a copy on the open shelf
nonGoals.why: The member can take that copy now.
Few members asked for it, and it doubles the cases the line must handle.

requirements.title: Place a hold on a book that is out
requirements.text: When every copy of a book is lent, a member can join the line for it from the book page and sees their place.

requirements.title: The first in line gets the returned copy
requirements.text: A returned copy goes to the first member in line, and nobody else can take it from the hold shelf.

requirements.title: Three opening days to pick it up
requirements.text: The member hears the same day the copy is shelved, and has three opening days to collect it. After that it passes to the next member.

requirements.title: See every hold in one place
requirements.text: A member sees each hold with their place in line, or the day to pick it up by.

requirements.title: Cancel a hold
requirements.text: A member can cancel any hold, and a desk librarian can cancel one for them. The line moves up.

rollout.says: Desk librarians try holds on their own library cards for one week.
Members of the central branch see Place a hold on the book page.
Every member sees it, and the desk stops taking paper holds.

risks.title: A librarian lends a held copy to the wrong member
risks.bound: The printed slip is the only guard until the desk app reads holds. The night report lists copies lent while held.

risks.title: Ready emails land in spam
risks.bound: My holds shows ready holds too, so a member who checks it still sees the day.

risks.title: The night run misses a day
risks.bound: The next run passes on every copy past its day, so a copy waits one extra day at most.

defaults.says: Three opening days count from the morning after a copy is shelved.
defaults.note: The desk asked for opening days. Calendar days would be simpler.

defaults.says: The pickup branch is the member's home branch unless they pick another.

items.title: Behavior
items.why: One rule still breaks in this plan.

says.TypeOK: Every value stays in its allowed set
says.HeldForSomeone: A copy on the hold shelf is always held for a member
says.NoTurnSkipped: The desk never lends a held copy to someone else
says.OneHoldPerMember: A member is in line for a book at most once
says.OpenShelfOnlyWhenNobodyWaits: A copy goes on the open shelf only when nobody waits for it
says.PickupWindowKept: A copy waits on the hold shelf for three days at most
says.NoDeadlock: The copy can always move on

terms.means: the shelf behind the desk where a copy waits for the member it is held for.
the shelves any member can borrow from.
the paper the desk prints with the member's name and puts in the copy.

runs.label: This plan
runs.note: The plan as it stands. A cancel on the shelf passes the copy on. The desk app still does not read holds.

runs.label: Before review
runs.note: The plan before review. A cancel on the shelf left the copy held for nobody.

parked.PickupWindowKept: The model counts whole days. R3 counts opening days, which the model leaves out.

plan:NoTurnSkipped.text: The desk app does not read holds, so a librarian can lend a copy from the hold shelf to the wrong member.

chosen: Print a hold slip with the member's name, and leave the desk app as it is
The desk puts the slip in the copy when it shelves it, and reads it before lending. The model cannot show that a person reads it.
other: Block the loan in the desk app
Another team owns the desk app and ships it monthly, so this plan would wait for its next release.

draft:HeldForSomeone.text: Before review, a member who cancelled a hold on the shelf left the copy held for nobody. Now the cancel passes the copy to the next member, or to the open shelf.

items.title: Data
items.why: One new table stores every hold.

body.says: book_holds stores the line for each book: one row per hold, read in placed_at order. Two partial unique indexes keep one open hold per member and book, and one hold per shelved copy.

tables.name: book_holds
tables.role: One row per hold. A book's line is its waiting rows.

states: the member it waits for cancels

unused.why: Reserved for pausing a hold, a non-goal.

items.title: API
items.why: Three new endpoints, and cancel takes a new permission.

access.who: Members for their own holds. Desk librarians for any hold.

body.envelope: T, or { message: string } on an error

shapes.Hold:
{
  id: string
  bookId: string
  title: string
  status: 'waiting' | 'on_shelf'
  place: number | null      // while waiting
  pickupBy: string | null   // ISO, while on the shelf
  placedAt: string
}

options.label: Yes, any desk librarian
options.detail: Members often ask at the desk. This needs the new permission.

options.label: No, only the member
options.detail: No new permission, and the desk sends members to the website.
